vintage: GUS population 31 December 2025; demographic rates and life expectancy 2025; university students 31 December 2025; territorial division 1 January 2026; GUS, October 2026, May 2026, and December 2025

fields.label: TERYT
fields.description: TERYT 7-digit gmina code (2026), with the type digit.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Urban, rural or urban-rural gmina.

fields.label: Population
fields.description: Residents on 31 December 2025 (GUS).

fields.label: Area
fields.description: Area on 1 January 2026 (GUS).

fields.label: Density
fields.description: Residents per km² (GUS, 31 December 2025; area on 1 January 2026).

fields.label: Median age
fields.description: Median age of residents, worked out from the GUS five-year age groups of 31 December 2025 by linear interpolation inside the group that holds the middle resident.

fields.label: Change 2015-2025
fields.description: Population on 31 December 2025 ÷ population on 31 December 2015 - 1 (GUS). Each year is on its own borders: a gmina whose borders changed (Opole in 2017, Kamienica and Supraśl in 2025) shows that change too.

fields.label: Net migration
fields.description: People who moved in minus people who moved out, within Poland and from abroad, per 1,000 residents (GUS, 2025).

fields.label: Aged 65+
fields.description: Residents aged 65 or more ÷ all residents (GUS, 31 December 2025).

fields.label: Births
fields.description: Live births per 1,000 residents (GUS, 2025).

fields.label: Ukrainians (PESEL UKR)
fields.description: Ukrainian citizens with a PESEL UKR number (temporary protection) registered in the powiat, per 1,000 residents. The register shows where the number was issued, not where the person lives now. Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value.

fields.label: PIT revenue per person
fields.description: The gmina's share of personal income tax planned for 2026 ÷ residents (Ministry of Finance, GUS population of 31 December 2025). It follows residents' taxable incomes.

fields.label: Average wage
fields.description: Average gross monthly wage, by employer seat (GUS wage distribution, May 2026). Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value.

fields.label: Unemployment
fields.description: Registered unemployment rate, end of October 2026 (GUS). Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value.

fields.label: New dwellings
fields.description: Dwellings completed in 2025 per 1,000 residents (GUS). Published per voivodeship: every gmina shows its voivodeship's value.

fields.label: Higher education
fields.description: Residents aged 13 or more with a higher-education diploma (NSP 2021 census, 31 March 2021). Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value.

fields.label: University students
fields.description: Students of the universities in the gmina, per 1,000 residents (GUS, 31 December 2025). A student on two programmes counts twice. Gminas without a university are blank.

fields.label: Tourist nights
fields.description: Nights spent in tourist accommodation with 10 or more beds in 2025 ÷ residents (GUS). Published per voivodeship: every gmina shows its voivodeship's value.

fields.label: Doctors
fields.description: Doctors counted at their main place of work, per 10,000 residents (GUS, 2024). City powiats with big hospitals rank high, the rural powiats around them low. Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value.

fields.label: Life expectancy, women
fields.description: Life expectancy at birth of women (GUS, 2025). Published per voivodeship: every gmina shows its voivodeship's value.

fields.label: Life expectancy, men
fields.description: Life expectancy at birth of men (GUS, 2025). Published per voivodeship: every gmina shows its voivodeship's value.

fields.label: Roman Catholic
fields.description: Residents who declared the Roman Catholic Church, as a share of all residents (NSP 2021 census). About a fifth of residents (21% in Poland) did not answer the voluntary question.

fields.label: No religion
fields.description: Residents who declared no religion, as a share of all residents (NSP 2021 census).

fields.label: Mass attendance
fields.description: Dominicantes: the share of Catholics obliged to attend who were at Sunday Mass on the October 2024 count (ISKK, Annuarium Statisticum Ecclesiae in Polonia). Published per Catholic diocese: every gmina shows the diocese of its seat.

fields.label: President 2025
fields.description: Second round, 1 June 2025: Karol Nawrocki's share of valid votes (PKW). The rest went to Rafał Trzaskowski.

fields.label: Turnout 2025
fields.description: Valid ballot papers ÷ eligible voters, presidential election second round, 1 June 2025 (PKW).

fields.label: Sejm 2023
fields.description: The committee with the most valid votes in the gmina, Sejm election of 15 October 2023 (PKW).

fields.label: PM2.5
fields.description: Annual mean of PM2.5 in 2025 at the nearest GIOŚ measuring station within 25 km of the gmina's centre. Gminas with no station that close are blank. A station measures its street or district, not the whole gmina.

fields.label: 2024 flood
fields.description: Gminas named in the state of natural disaster declared for the September 2024 flood (Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1365 and amendments).

fields.label: Forest
fields.description: Share of the land with tree cover (ESA WorldCover 2021), averaged over the gmina's hex samples.

fields.label: Farmland
fields.description: Share of the land in cropland or meadow and pasture below 900 m (ESA WorldCover 2021).

fields.label: Built-up
fields.description: Share of the land that is built up (ESA WorldCover 2021).

fields.label: Workers
fields.description: People working, by employer seat (GUS, 31 December 2025, gmina sector table).

fields.label: GDP (share)
fields.description: The gmina's share of its powiat's GDP 2023 (see the Gold yield).

fields.label: Air station
fields.description: The GIOŚ station the PM2.5 value comes from, with its distance.

fields.label: Metro
fields.description: The metro (Eurostat functional urban area) the gmina belongs to.

fields.label: Cell
fields.description: A representative hex of the gmina.
